caption: ROUGE-1 metric for fine-tuning MBart and T5 models with adapters with different r with WikiHow dataset
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the ROUGE-1 scores achieved by fine-tuning T5 and MBart models with LoRA and AdaLoRA adapters across varying values of the rank parameter r, using the WikiHow dataset. The x-axis, labeled “log r,” spans from 0 to 9 on a linear scale, with major tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled “ROUGE-1,” ranges from 0 to 35, also on a linear scale, with major gridlines every 5 units. Four distinct lines are plotted: T5 + LoRA (red circles connected by solid lines) starts at approximately 23.0 at log r = 0, rises to a peak of ~28.5 at log r = 3, then gradually declines to ~27.0 at log r = 9. MBart + LoRA (purple circles, solid line) begins at ~12.0, dips to ~5.0 at log r = 1, then sharply increases to ~27.0 at log r = 4, stabilizing near 27.0 through log r = 9. T5 + AdaLoRA (green circles, solid line) starts at ~23.0, steadily climbs to ~36.0 by log r = 4, and remains flat at ~36.0 for all higher values of log r. MBart + AdaLoRA (orange circles, solid line) begins at ~12.0, rises steeply to ~21.0 at log r = 2, continues increasing to ~33.5 at log r = 9, showing a consistent upward trend throughout the range.
